metadata.description: We help you make the sustainable choice your go-to!

workflows.name: Extension Installation/Update Flow
steps: Sets uninstall URL.
Creates context menu.
Runs after-install logic (A/B test setup, analytics event, open onboarding tab) or updates Mixpanel profile.
messages: mixpanel (sent to background from content.js for tracking, background sends to Mixpanel)

workflows.name: User Authentication Flow
steps: Stores/clears auth data in storage.
Distributes auth/logout messages to all content scripts.

workflows.name: Supported Website Check & Embedded View Flow
triggers: isSupportedWebsite message from content to background
steps: Content script checks if host is supported for embedding and if elements are available.
Content script injects embedded iframe.
Background script retrieves supported sites data (from cache or API) and checks if the URL is supported.

workflows.name: Analytics & Telemetry Flow
triggers: Explicit mixpanel messages from content script
steps: Gathers event data (name, properties, machine key, browser, time, URL).
Sends data to Mixpanel API.

workflows.name: Catalogue Redirection Flow (A/B Test)
steps: Assigns a unique redirection key.
Stores page data in session storage associated with the redirection key.
Opens a new tab to the Faircado catalogue redirector with the redirection ID.

workflows.name: Image Search Flow
steps: Background script sends `showExtension` message to content script with `imageUrl` and `manualImageSearch` flag.
Content script then uses `save.html` iframe to process the image, converting it to base64.
Processed image data is sent back to the content script.

workflows.name: Session Storage Proxy Flow
triggers: Content script calls to sessionStorage methods (setItem, getItem, removeItem, clear) from browser-storage.ts
steps: Content script sends internal messages to the background script to perform session storage operations.
Background script executes the requested session storage operations.

workflows.name: Data Control UI Flow
triggers: User opens data-control.html (e.g., after extension install, or if data control is not accepted)
steps: Displays privacy information and data usage disclosures.
Offers options to activate or uninstall the extension.
Interacts with data-control.js to perform activation (setting 'activated' flag and redirecting) or uninstallation.

risks.justification: Extensive use of Mixpanel for detailed event tracking, user profile updates, and experiment tracking, correlated with unique `machineKey` and browsing URLs. This enables comprehensive tracking of user behavior across websites.

`activeTab` and `tabs` permissions grant broad access to user browsing data. `host_permissions` for `https://*/*` allow content scripts to run on virtually all secure websites, enabling extensive data extraction and DOM manipulation. While justified for core functionality, the scope is wide.

OAuth2 scope requests `userinfo.email`. If `authKey`/`authValue` in storage contain PII, and this data is handled insecurely or exfiltrated, it poses a risk. The `machineKey` is a persistent identifier. While direct exfiltration of PII *to a third party beyond Faircado's own backend* was not explicitly found in the analyzed code, the potential exists given broad data access.

Authentication data (`authKey`, `authValue`) and `machineKey` are stored in `localStorage` and `chrome.storage.sync`. `localStorage` is vulnerable to XSS if a content script is compromised, but `chrome.storage.sync` offers some browser-level security. Session storage is used for temporary redirection data.

The extension fetches A/B test configurations and general extension configurations from remote CMS APIs (`cms-api.faircado.com`). While these are configuration data, changes to these remote configurations could dynamically alter extension behavior, including data extraction patterns, UI injection logic, and even analytics tracking, without requiring a new extension update. This creates a dependency on the security and integrity of these remote servers.
